kind: Independent conditional native scalar edge harness review
stage: Initial reviewed run; open harness findings, retain as historical on fix
disposition: Finite oracle/results are consistent; four harness/evidence custody corrections remain before treating this as final qualified component evidence.

findings.subject: Owned PostgreSQL volume cleanup is incomplete
findings.evidence: Only docker rm -f is used; no mount retention, anonymous-volume deletion, shared-user guard or final successful absence inventory. Receipt records removal exit code only.
findings.fix: Capture and retain original owned mounts, verify exact ownership and no shared volume users, remove owned anonymous volumes with the container, and verify both absent before publishing.

findings.subject: Unrelated ValueError can satisfy a semantic refusal
findings.evidence: Any ValueError, including JSONDecodeError from malformed producer output, is counted as compile refusal. Four current actual codes are three WFT-NUMERIC-DOMAIN and one WFT-PARAMETER.
findings.fix: Require exact expected diagnostic from the original producer invocation; parsing/artifact errors must fail the harness rather than count as capability refusal.

findings.subject: Incomplete executed-harness and import custody
findings.evidence: Own runner/generator and installed Python shim are not included in before/after pins. A present matching .so does not by itself identify the loaded extension. Source checks precede cleanup.
findings.fix: Pin executed harness/generator/shim and confirm actual loaded extension origin/hash against wheel; recheck selected endpoints after cleanup before success publication. Current reviewer comparison independently confirms shim matches wheel now, but not during prior execution.

findings.subject: A failed rerun can leave an old passing receipt beside new artifacts
findings.source: run.py fixed output directory and final success-only receipt write
findings.evidence: Existing receipt.json is not invalidated before compilation; per-case compiled artifacts are overwritten before success.
findings.fix: Use a fresh per-attempt output directory or publish pending/invalidate prior current success before any compile, with exact attempt correlation on all retained artifacts.

independentChecks.nativeExecution: Parent run inspected, not independently rerun

soundnessNotes: UTF8 byte order oracle is independently computed from explicit strings, including whitespace/control/quotes/combining forms/astral/max scalar values; exact returned string comparison performs no normalization.
Unordered native rows are compared as complete sorted lists, preserving multiplicity; numeric equality edge expectations use mathematical int64 values without JavaScript conversion.
Native text output OIDs and computed result descriptor expectations are checked; salary projections remain synthetic masked strings, not raw int64 output qualification.
Removed eligibility SQL filter changes count32 to33 and is a useful physical SQL sensitivity witness only.
Binding modes/actions/comparisonScope and staged eligibility/value provenance are explicit assumptions; no permission/current issuer/guarded release/native acceptance is claimed.
limits: Frozen source manifest plus matching binary/wheel are selected provenance evidence, not independently established build reproducibility or hermetic execution.
All driver dependencies and whole-process transient memory are outside these claims.
